<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant ion at m/z 114.06808, which in positive‑mode ESI is most likely the [M + H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈113.0608 Da. The formula C₆H₉O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 113.060255 Da, matching the observed mass within the experimental tolerance. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C₆H₉O₂.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
